title: Consistency Models
subtitle: Consistency is a dial, and quorums let you set it per operation
motto: Overlap the write set and the read set
keyInsight: When the replicas a write reaches and the replicas a read asks must overlap (W + R > N), every read sees the latest write, at the price of waiting for more replicas.

decisions.title: Compute the stale-read chance exactly
decisions.description: The chance a read misses the latest write is a small combinatorial formula, so the sim shows an exact number rather than a random sample.
decisions.alternatives: Running random trials would be noisier and would need a seed, and would hide why the probability drops to exactly zero at W + R > N.

decisions.title: Use the same quorum for reads and writes in the main frames
decisions.description: One quorum slider keeps the model to one idea; the trade-off frame then shows the asymmetric setting (write to all, read from one).
decisions.alternatives: Separate W and R sliders give more freedom but make it easy to lose the point of the overlap rule.
